content_units: Best Laptop Pick for a CS Student

For your priorities—  battery life first, portability second, light gaming third, under $1,200  —the   MacBook Air M2   is the best overall fit. The   Acer Swift Go 14   is the best value pick, and the   ASUS TUF A15   is the best if gaming matters more than carrying comfort or battery life.
Rank   Laptop   Price   Weight   Battery   Light Gaming   Best For
1   MacBook Air M2   $1,199   1.24 kg   15 hours   Moderate   Best overall balance of portability + battery
2   Acer Swift Go 14   $899   1.32 kg   9 hours   Basic to light   Best value for student productivity
3   ASUS TUF A15   $1,149   2.2 kg   6 hours   Strong   Best gaming performance, weaker for campus carry
- Best   battery life   by a wide margin.
- Lightest practical everyday choice for campus use.
- Strong performance for coding, browsing, documents, and most CS coursework.
- Not the best gaming machine of the three.
- Some CS tools/classes may be easier on Windows, depending on your program.
- Limited port selection compared with many Windows laptops.
- If you want the laptop that feels best for   all-day classes, library work, and commuting  , this is the winner.
- Much cheaper than the MacBook while still being light and student-friendly.
- Good balance of portability and decent battery life.
- Intel Core Ultra 5 + 16GB RAM is solid for programming, note-taking, browser tabs, and general school use.
- Battery life is clearly behind the MacBook.
- Light gaming is more limited than on the ASUS TUF A15.
- Overall “premium longevity” and unplugged endurance are not as strong as the MacBook Air.
- Best choice if you want to   save $300   and still get a very practical CS student laptop.
- Easily the best for gaming thanks to the   RTX 4050  .
- Also very capable for heavier workloads and GPU-based tasks.
- Much heavier at   2.2 kg  , which is a big downside for daily campus carry.
- Weakest battery life of the three.
- Bulkier gaming-laptop design makes it less convenient for classes and travel.
- Pick this only if   gaming is more important   to you than battery life and portability.
If your priorities changed to   gaming first  , then the ranking would become:
- Choose   MacBook Air M2   if you want the   best overall student experience  .
- Choose   Acer Swift Go 14   if you want the   smartest budget-conscious pick  .
- Choose   ASUS TUF A15   if you want the   strongest gaming performance   and can accept the weight and battery hit.
